messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a prod cutover for inference-runtime v3.4.1 in 20m (15:10 UTC). Canary: lane-alpha (5% for 10m) -> lane-beta (25% for 15m) -> full. No model changes, runtime-only patch (latency fix).

katie: ack. I can be on-call for approval and rollout toggle.

ryan: I'll run the smoke checklist and watch the canary dashboards. ping me when canary is live.

dina: rollback artifacts ready. rollback tag: runtime/v3.4.0-rollback. DB migrations: none. config flags: use_runtime_v341 (bool).

alex: quick checklist — please react with :white_check_mark: when done:
- [ ] infra gate (ops)
- [ ] sig-perf quick smoke
- [ ] canary watchers ack
- [ ] rollback tested on staging

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 15:10-15:50 UTC. Owner: alex. Canary lanes: lane-alpha, lane-beta. Auto-fallback enabled.

ryan: infra gate — confirmed (spot pool healthy, GPUs ok). :white_check_mark:

katie: sig-perf smoke run started. Will post results in ~8m.

sre-oncall: dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/inference?orgId=1 — monitoring alerts set: latency>1200ms, p95>900ms, error-rate>0.5%

ryan: smoke commands (run on prod-smoke host):
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" "https://prod-api.redwood/v1/generate?model=redwood-alpha" 
./scripts/smoke_inference.sh --endpoint https://prod-api.redwood --concurrency 5 --tokens 50
```

dina: rollback verified on staging: steps tested:
1) toggle use_runtime_v341=false
2) redeploy runtime/v3.4.0 image
3) clear KV cache on inference nodes
All good. :thumbsup:

katie: perf smoke results: p50/p95 unchanged, tail latency slightly improved. No errors observed in 1k req sample. :white_check_mark:

alex: OK — owners and gates look green. plan:
- T+0: enable lane-alpha at 5%
- T+10m: if stable, enable lane-beta at 25%
- T+25m: if stable, promote to 100%
- If any critical alert -> immediate rollback with tag runtime/v3.4.0-rollback

ryan: I'll flip the canary toggle and post timestamps. Keeping watch.

deploy-bot: Canary lane-alpha enabled at 15:10:30 UTC for 5% traffic.

katie: watching logs and perf, no regressions so far.

sre-oncall: CPU/GPU and infra metrics stable. No OOMs.

ryan: 15:20 UTC — lane-alpha healthy, p95 720ms, error-rate 0.02%.

alex: proceeding to lane-beta (25%).

deploy-bot: lane-beta enabled at 15:21:10 UTC for 25% traffic.

katie: monitoring — minor increase in tail but within SLO. continuing.

ryan: 15:36 UTC — lane-beta stable for 15m. Promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: promotion started at 15:36:55 UTC -> 100% traffic.

sre-oncall: full-rollout watch on dashboards. alert hooks live.

dina: rollback steps on standby. I have creds and runbook open.

alex: all green — closing window. please add final reactions and update the release notes with runtime.v3.4.1 -> production at 15:40 UTC.

katie: :white_check_mark: release notes updated.

ryan: :white_check_mark: smoke completed, no follow-ups.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete at 15:40:12 UTC. tags: runtime/v3.4.1 -> prod. Metrics: p95 -5%.

alex: thanks team! we'll monitor for the next 2 hours but looks good.
